title: 讀懂波斯地毯紋樣
body:
從形狀開始，追問背景，保留不確定性。

Persian Rug Motifs: Forms, Context, and Meanings

五個主題，一套可以回查來源的閱讀方法。
note: 給初學者的入門課。繁體中文及術語暫譯尚未經人工專業審閱。
body_en:
Start with form, ask about context, and keep uncertainty visible.

Persian Rug Motifs: Forms, Context, and Meanings.

Five topics and a method for tracing information to its sources.
note_en: An introductory lesson. Traditional Chinese translations and descriptive terms have not been reviewed by a human specialist.

title: 先觀察，再解釋
body:
觀察 Observation：描述看得見的形狀。

歷史主張 Historical claim：回查年代、材質與產地紀錄。

詮釋 Interpretation：說明由誰提出、依據是什麼。

不確定 Uncertain：證據不足，就不下結論。
note: 這四類是本專案的編輯規則，不是地毯本身的分類。
body_en:
Observation: describe visible shapes.

Historical claim: check records for dates, materials and origin.

Interpretation: identify who proposed it and the supporting evidence.

Uncertain: do not draw a conclusion when evidence is insufficient.
note_en: These four categories are this project’s editorial rules, not classifications of rugs.

title: 先找地心與邊框
body:
地心（field / matn / متن）是邊框內的主要區域。

主邊框、次邊框與窄分隔帶，幫助我們定位紋樣。

先說「在哪裡」，再說「像什麼」。
visual:
Original teaching schematic / 原創教學示意圖
Not a historical object or an identification template.
body_en:
The field (matn / متن) is the main area inside the borders.

Main borders, minor borders and narrow guard bands help locate a motif.

Describe where it is before describing what it resembles.

title: 紋樣、圖案與布局
body:
紋樣 motif：一個裝飾單元。

圖案 pattern：單元之間的排列與重複。

布局 composition：整張地毯的組織。
visual:
Original teaching schematic / 原創教學示意圖
Not a historical object or an identification template.
note: 本課的五個主題屬於不同層次，不能全部當作單一符號。
body_en:
Motif: one decorative unit.

Pattern: the arrangement and repetition of units.

Composition: the organization of the whole rug.
note_en: The five topics operate at different levels. They are not all single symbols.

title: Boteh：彎尖水滴紋
body:
波斯語：بته‌جقه（boteh-jegheh）

觀察圓潤輪廓與彎曲尖端。

Getty 將它與 paisley 聯繫。形狀相近，不代表已知道織者的寓意。
visual:
Original teaching schematic / 原創教學示意圖
Not a historical object or an identification template.
body_en:
Persian: بته‌جقه (boteh-jegheh).

Look for a rounded outline and a curved tip.

Getty connects this form with paisley. Recognizing a shape does not establish the weaver’s intended meaning.

title: Herati / Mahi：看整組排列
body:
هراتی / ماهی‌درهم（herāti / māhi darham）

尋找菱形、中央花形與周圍彎葉的組合。

「魚」的名稱與葉片外觀有關，不是要求找到寫實魚圖。
visual:
Original teaching schematic / 原創教學示意圖
Not a historical object or an identification template.
title_en: Herati / Mahi: read the whole repeat
body_en:
هراتی / ماهی‌درهم (herāti / māhi darham).

Look for the combination of a diamond, central flower and surrounding curved leaves.

The “fish” name relates to the appearance of the leaves. It does not require a realistic fish image.

title: Shah Abbasi：名稱也有層次
body:
شاه‌عباسی（shāh-abbāsi）

扇形花紋（palmette）是概括化的花形。

Shah Abbasi 也可指更完整的花卉圖案。不能憑名稱判定年代。
visual:
Original teaching schematic / 原創教學示意圖
Not a historical object or an identification template.
title_en: Shah Abbasi: more than one naming level
body_en:
شاه‌عباسی (shāh-abbāsi).

A palmette is a stylized fan-like flower.

Shah Abbasi can also name a broader floral pattern. The name alone does not establish a date.

title: Islimi：沿著卷草走
body:
اسلیمی（eslimi / islimi），arabesque

沿分枝與曲線閱讀，而不只盯著一朵花。

右圖的藍色卷草帶與小花共存。館方產地標示為「可能是伊朗」。
body_en:
اسلیمی (eslimi / islimi), arabesque.

Follow branches and curves rather than concentrating on one flower.

In the museum example, blue scrolling bands coexist with small flowers. The museum labels its origin “probably Iran.”

title: Toranj 與 Lachak：中央與四角
body:
ترنج و لچک（toranj va lachak）

先辨認中央團花，再看角隅如何呼應。

中央團花內仍可包含其他小紋樣。
visual:
Original teaching schematic / 原創教學示意圖
Not a historical object or an identification template.
title_en: Toranj and Lachak: centre and corners
body_en:
ترنج و لچک (toranj va lachak).

Identify the central medallion, then examine how the corners echo it.

A medallion can itself contain smaller motifs.

title: 練習：你在辨認哪個層次？
body:
哪一個重點是整組重複？哪一個重點是中心與四角？

顯示答案

Herati 要看整組重複。Toranj / Lachak 要看中心與角隅。單一局部裁切可能缺少判讀所需的關係。

title_en: Exercise: which level are you identifying?
body_en:
Which topic concerns an entire repeating unit? Which concerns the centre and corners?

Show answer

Herati requires reading the whole repeat. Toranj / Lachak concerns the centre and corners. A small crop may omit the relationships needed for identification.

title: 歷史背景不等於固定象徵
body:
V&A 對 Ardabil 地毯大小不同的燈，介紹了透視效果與刻意不完美等解釋。

它同時指出透視說的證據問題，也沒有列出個別提出者。

因此應說「館方介紹一種解釋」，而不是「織者一定想表達……」。
note: 本 Wiki 不把任何紋樣解讀成唯一、普遍的寓意，也不加入虛構故事。
title_en: Historical context is not a fixed meaning
body_en:
The V&A discusses perspective and deliberate imperfection as possible explanations for the Ardabil Carpet’s unequal lamps.

It also questions the evidence for perspective and does not name the individual proponents.

Say “the museum presents an interpretation,” rather than claiming certainty about the weaver’s intention.
note_en: This Wiki assigns no universal meaning to a motif and contains no fictional stories.

title: 收藏理解：材質、密度、染料
body:
材質：分開記錄絨面與底組織。

打結密度：說清楚計量單位，不直接換算價格。

染料：需要紀錄或檢驗，螢幕上的顏色不能證明成分。
note: 這是理解與紀錄的框架，不是估價或購買建議。
body_en:
Materials: record the pile and foundation separately.

Knot density: state the measurement unit. Do not convert it directly into a price.

Dyes: consult documentation or analysis. Screen colour cannot prove chemical composition.
note_en: This is a framework for understanding and documentation, not an appraisal or buying recommendation.

title: 保存、年代與來源紀錄
body:
保存狀況（condition）：是否有缺損、修補及檢查報告？

年代（age）：有銘文或分析支持嗎？Cleveland 的一件殘片經染料分析後，改定為 1884–1928 年。

來源紀錄（provenance）：誰曾擁有？不確定的轉手與年份要保留。
note: 紋樣本身不能決定價值。外觀古老也不等於年代已獲證明。
body_en:
Condition: are losses, repairs and examination reports documented?

Age: is it supported by an inscription or analysis? Dye analysis led Cleveland to date one fragment to 1884–1928.

Provenance: who owned it? Keep uncertain transfers and dates visible.
note_en: A motif alone does not determine value. An old-looking appearance does not establish age.

title: 練習閱讀一件館藏
body:
Met 22.100.67：先看殘片，再讀館藏說明。

你能看到什麼？哪些資訊必須查紀錄？

顯示證據分層

觀察：不完整的輪廓與裝飾。館藏紀錄：十六世紀初、伊朗西北部。推定：原本可能位於較大中央團花上方。不能從殘片確知整張地毯或織者心意。
body_en:
Met 22.100.67: examine the fragment, then read the museum description.

What can you see? Which information requires a record?

Show evidence layers

Observation: an incomplete outline and decoration. Museum record: early sixteenth century, Northwestern Iran. Reconstruction: probably above a larger central medallion. The fragment cannot establish the full design or the weaver’s intention.

title: 帶走三個習慣
body:
先描述形狀與布局。

再查可追溯的來源。

最後說清楚還不知道什麼。

回到英文 Wiki · 術語表 · 來源筆記
note: 下一步可以比較新的館藏，但新主張必須先進入 Wiki 並完成查核。
body_en:
Describe form and layout first.

Consult traceable sources next.

Finally, explain what remains unknown.

English Wiki · Glossary · Source notes
note_en: You can compare another museum object next, but new claims must first enter the Wiki and be checked.

title: 附錄一：資料如何變成簡報
body:
取得公開資料建立證據筆記整理連結 Wiki檢查主張與圖片權利確認大綱翻譯與編排測試 HTML

引用不足就回到資料節點；術語不清就先修改 Wiki；畫面或連結失敗就修正後重測。
note: 同一主張三次修訂仍無法支持，就標記未解決並交由人工檢查。
body_en:
Acquire public sources; create evidence notes; organize a linked Wiki; check claims and image rights; approve the outline; translate and lay out slides; test the HTML.

Insufficient citation returns to sources. Unclear terminology returns to the Wiki. Layout or link failures are repaired and retested.
note_en: After three unsuccessful revisions of a claim, mark it unresolved and refer it for human review.

title: 附錄二：本次執行的檢查紀錄
body:
圖片候選：排除被誤選作波斯例子的埃及 Mamluk 地毯。

年代交叉檢查：發現舊參考資料與 V&A 的 Ardabil 年代不同，採用目前保管館的紀錄並保留差異。

公開不等於可再利用：V&A 圖片改為外部連結。

開啟完整實際紀錄與測試結果
note: 紀錄只描述這次真正遇到的問題，不虛構測試數字。
body_en:
Image screening: rejected an Egyptian Mamluk carpet as a Persian example.

Date comparison: found different Ardabil dates in an older reference and the V&A record. Used the current holding museum’s record and retained the discrepancy.

Public access is not permission to reuse: V&A images became external links.

Read the actual log and test results
note_en: The log records actual problems from this run, not invented test statistics.

title: 附錄三：反思與下一輪
body:
這次最需要人工注意的是來源到主張的轉換：產地、年代、用詞的保留。

因此把文化歸屬、權利與「可能」等限定詞的檢查，移到編排之前。

這只有一次執行，不能推論長期哪個節點最常失敗。繁體中文仍待人工審閱。
note: 未來 Rug Detective 可重用證據 ID，但影像辨認仍需人工確認，故事必須另標為虛構。
body_en:
The source-to-claim step needed the most editorial attention: origin, date and careful wording.

Cultural attribution, rights and qualifiers such as “probably” are now checked before layout.

One run cannot establish which node fails most often over time. Traditional Chinese still needs human review.
note_en: A future Rug Detective can reuse evidence IDs. Motif identification still needs human confirmation, and stories must be labelled fiction.
